_schema: LIHTC maximum rents by AMI band for restricted NOI used only to size a recast or 0% recap gap on our_book rows. PLACEHOLDER: every rent is null until the user pastes the current HUD/OHCS limits; while null, est_restricted_noi is blank and the lead carries 'Missing Source — Request Document' (rent roll from the agency file); there is no market $/unit fallback. Populate from the OHCS Income and Rent Limits page (MTSP limits, Portland-Vancouver-Hillsboro MSA) and record as_of and source.
source: OHCS Income and Rent Limits (MTSP) for the Portland-Vancouver-Hillsboro, OR-WA HUD Metro FMR Area; URL to be confirmed (oregon.gov not fetched in this build)
unit_mix_assumption: rents are blended across bedroom sizes; when the property's unit mix is known, replace with a weighted figure per band
notes: Gross rent limits include a utility allowance; net the allowance before using as collectable rent.
HOME and OAHTC rents can be lower than the LIHTC limit for the same AMI band; use the binding restriction.
Market-rate units in a mixed property use market-params asking_rent_by_bedroom with the Class C haircut.
